method: Append-only audit: exact old PNG bytes and existing style/face metadata; pose metadata fixed except exact hair-bound unions; all new layer frames decoded with meaningful alpha, owned pixels and clear output margins. Original source, garments, donors, registrations and compositor retained. Numeric/artifact checks do not establish visual acceptance.

legacyHairBoundsAudit.method: For every baseline hair layer frame, decode original RGBA pixels; translate all nonzero-alpha pixels by frame.offset; assert their pixel centers are inside the original pose.hairBounds using the production renderer half-pixel containment convention. No bank or source is changed.

contractEvidence.behavior: Import checks every owned hair pixel center against its pose.hairBounds and rejects an out-of-bounds bank.
Rendering throws on a hairBounds violation; the rectangle is not a silent crop or blending input.

legacyHairBoundsAudit.conclusion: All nonzero-alpha pixels in every legacy hair layer frame were already inside the previous hairBounds. Because old PNG bytes, layer/frame mappings, other pose metadata and renderer bytes are unchanged, expanding only hairBounds cannot expose additional old-style pixels in any pose. No bank or source asset was changed for this audit.
